executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors during test compilation phase. The root cause is a mismatch between DTO constructors and service method signatures versus their usage in test classes. DTOs are being instantiated with arguments but are defined with no-argument constructors, and service methods are being called with incorrect parameter counts and types (long vs String/UUID).

errors.message: Multiple DTO constructors cannot be applied: TaskCreateRequest, TaskResponse, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse require no arguments but are called with arguments
errors.root_cause: DTOs are defined with no-argument constructors (likely using Lombok @NoArgsConstructor) but test code attempts to instantiate them using all-args constructors. The DTOs need @AllArgsConstructor or builder pattern.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @AllArgsConstructor annotation to TaskCreateRequest, TaskResponse, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskCountResponse, and BulkTaskResponse DTOs, or use builder pattern with @Builder annotation.

errors.message: Method createTask in TaskService cannot be applied: required (String, TaskCreateRequest), found (TaskCreateRequest)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() expects userId as first parameter (String) but test code calls it with only TaskCreateRequest. Service interface signature changed but tests not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all createTask() calls in TaskControllerTest to include userId as first parameter: taskService.createTask(userId, request)

errors.message: Method getUserTasks in TaskService cannot be applied: required (String, int, int, String), found (long, int, int)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() expects userId as String and sortBy parameter, but test code passes long userId without sortBy. Parameter types and count mismatch.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update getUserTasks() calls to: taskService.getUserTasks(String.valueOf(userId), page, size, sortBy) or change service signature to accept long userId.

errors.message: Method getTaskById in TaskService cannot be applied: required (UUID, String), found (long)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getTaskById() expects UUID taskId and String userId, but test code passes only long. Task ID type changed from long to UUID.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update getTaskById() calls to: taskService.getTaskById(UUID.fromString(taskId), userId) and change test data to use UUID instead of long.

errors.message: Method updateTask in TaskService cannot be applied: required (UUID, String, TaskUpdateRequest), found (long, TaskUpdateRequest)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.updateTask() expects UUID taskId, String userId, and TaskUpdateRequest, but test code passes long taskId without userId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update updateTask() calls to: taskService.updateTask(UUID.fromString(taskId), userId, request) with proper UUID and userId parameters.

errors.message: Method deleteTask in TaskService cannot be applied: required (UUID, String), found (long)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.deleteTask() expects UUID taskId and String userId, but test code passes only long taskId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update deleteTask() calls to: taskService.deleteTask(UUID.fromString(taskId), userId) with proper UUID and userId parameters.

errors.message: Method bulkCreateTasks in TaskService cannot be applied: required (String, List<TaskCreateRequest>), found (Object)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks() expects userId and List of TaskCreateRequest, but test code passes incorrect parameter type.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update bulkCreateTasks() calls to: taskService.bulkCreateTasks(userId, Arrays.asList(request1, request2)) with proper userId and typed list.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method getCode() in ErrorResponse class
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO does not have a getCode() method but test code attempts to call it. Either the method was removed or never existed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getCode() method to ErrorResponse DTO or update test assertions to use the correct field accessor method.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method handleValidationErrors(MethodArgumentNotValidException) in GlobalExceptionHandler
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler does not have handleValidationErrors() method but test code attempts to call it. Method signature changed or was removed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add handleValidationErrors() method to GlobalExceptionHandler or update test to call the correct exception handler method.

errors.message: Type incompatibility: long cannot be converted to String, Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore expects String userId and TaskPriority enum, but test code passes long userId and Priority enum. Data types changed in the datastore interface.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest to use String.valueOf(userId) for userId parameters and TaskPriority enum instead of Priority enum.

errors.message: Bad operand types for binary operator '+': UUID + int
errors.root_cause: Test code attempts to concatenate UUID with int using + operator, which is not supported. UUID is not a numeric type.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the arithmetic operation on UUID. Use UUID.randomUUID() to generate new UUIDs instead of trying to increment them.
